args: Stock-count discrepancies by storage-location kind, company-wide

Across the whole company (not just the top warehouses by value), does the cycle-count mismatch concentrate in pick locations specifically, or do other location kinds (bulk, overflow, etc.) also carry meaningful discrepancy volume?
